newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Lundberg says not to sell MoDo stake.
newsitem.headline: Lundberg says not to sell MoDo stake.

text.p: Swedish financier Fredrik Lundberg said on Monday he had no plans to sell the Lundbergs group's stake in Swedish forestry group MoDo.
"I do not see any changes in our MoDo holding," Lundberg told Reuters.

Lundbergs holds 22.9 percent of capital and 49.6 percent of votes in MoDo and market players from time to time speculate the group might sell its stake to allow MoDo to be be taken over by a large foreign rival.
Lundbergs, the group's key holding company, said on Monday it had sold its 76.9 percent stake in Ostgota Enskilda bank to Danish banking group Den Danske Bank.
When Fredrik Lundberg was asked whether he had not said, in February, that the group would not divest its Ostgota Enskilda Bank stake he said:
"That might be possible...I am not so sure I knew about this then. The bid procedure has been relatively fast."
